title: Extracting Consumer Insight from Text: A Large Language Model Approach to Emotion and Evaluation Measurement
reasoning: The paper develops a model (LX) to measure marketing-specific constructs such as consumer emotions (e.g., joy, anger, shame) and evaluations (e.g., trust, commitment, recommendation). These constructs are derived from relationship marketing and consumer psychology scales rather than ethical, religious, or theological frameworks. The study is aimed at predicting consumer behavior and business outcomes rather than benchmarking moral or faith-based systems.
